subject: POC success slate, evaluation milestones & blocker playlist
messages:
From: Kate Miller <kate@heliumdata.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Greg Torres <greg.torres@heliumdata.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + ask: HeliumData POC scope

Marcus — thanks for the demo earlier. Quick recap from our side and the things we need to move to a formal POC: 

- Top success criteria (what our product team will measure):
  * Latency: 95th percentile under 350ms for 1k-token requests (chat-style)
  * Throughput: sustain 50 concurrent sessions for a 1-hour soak
  * Quality: >85% pass rate on our 120-case semantic-match suite (we'll provide testcases)
  * Cost visibility: per-token breakdown and a month-estimated cost for projected usage (1M tokens)

- Timeline: 4-week POC from kickoff (week 0 = config/kickoff).
- Data: we'll provide a 120-case test harness + 2 anonymized datasets for integration testing.
- Security: we'll need SOC2 evidence, network/IP whitelist, and an NDA addendum for the datasets.

Next steps from our side: procurement will share PO template; engineering will provide sample dataset and a list of whitelisted IPs. Can Redwood commit to a weekly sync and an escalation path for any blocking bugs?

Attachments: procurement-template.pdf (sent separately by procurement).

Thanks,
Kate
Product Ops — HeliumData

--
On Tue, Apr 10, 2028 at 09:12 AM Kate Miller <kate@heliumdata.com> wrote:
> Hey Marcus — great demo today. Looking forward to the POC.
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Kate Miller <kate@heliumdata.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + ask: HeliumData POC scope

Hi Kate — appreciate the clear notes. Below is our proposed POC playbook, owners, and immediate asks so we can lock kickoff for next Tuesday.

POC duration and cadence
- Duration: 4 weeks (config + 3 weeks active evaluation).
- Cadence: 30-min weekly syncs (Mon 10am PT), ad-hoc engineering triage sessions as needed.

Success criteria (mapped to your items)
- Latency: 95p < 350ms on a 1k-token chat path (owner: infra eng)
- Throughput: sustain 50 concurrent sessions for 1 hour (owner: infra eng + performance lead)
- Quality: >=85% on HeliumData 120-case suite (owner: solutions engineer)
- Cost: exportable per-token billing by route + estimate for 1M tokens (owner: product ops)

Evaluation plan and gates
- Week 0 (kickoff): environment setup, IP whitelist, sample data handoff, smoke tests. Gate: smoke tests pass.
- Week 1: first-run baseline results on 120-case suite. Gate: run completes and data captured.
- Week 2: performance soak (throughput/latency). Gate: 95p latency and backend error rate <0.5%.
- Week 3: reliability and cost analysis; final acceptance run. Gate: all criteria met or agreed remediation plan in place.

Ownership & contacts
- Redwood POC lead: Marcus Lin (marcus@redwood.com) — overall coordination, product ops
- Performance lead / infra: Lauren Bishop (lauren@redwood.com) — load tests and latency tuning
- Escalation / customer success: Stephanie Nguyen (stephanie@redwood.com) — commercial/escalation owner

Immediate asks for kickoff
1) HeliumData to share the 120-case test suite CSV and a sanitized sample dataset (DropBox/Drive link).
2) Procurement PO template (we'll review internally).
3) Whitelisted IP list or IP ranges for our infra team to configure.

Risk note: based on the demo, the main technical risk is network egress for embeddings and the integration with your internal routing. Our Week 0 checklist (attached) includes a network checklist and recommended kv-cache settings.

Attachments: mutual-success-criteria.xlsx, network-checklist.pdf

If next Tuesday 10am PT works for your team, I'll send a calendar invite and link the Drive folder for test data.

Thanks — Marcus
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

--
Marcus Lin
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Kate Miller <kate@heliumdata.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC success slate, evaluation milestones & blocker playlist

Looping in the high-level risk register so HeliumData and our engineering teams have visibility. I created a short CSV (attached) that we'll keep live during the POC. Top items now: 

1) Network whitelisting delays (blocking) — mitigation: pre-authorize IP ranges; if delayed, use a short-lived secure tunnel via our ops team. Escalation: Stephanie (customer success) -> infra oncall.
2) Model parity / accuracy regression on some edge cases — mitigation: parallel run against a warmed cache + fallback to a higher-capacity model variant. Escalation: Performance lead -> model ops.
3) Dataset formatting issues (blocking for Week 0) — mitigation: provide a sanitizer script and sample mapping; if blocked, we run a masked test harness. Owner: Marcus.
4) Critical bug in our inference runtime during performance soak — mitigation: isolate faulty nodes, reduce concurrency, collect traces; immediate patch window targeted within 48 hours. Escalation path: Lauren -> VP infra -> product on-call.

Escalation contacts (primary -> secondary):
- Commercial/contract: Stephanie Nguyen -> Marcus Lin
- Engineering urgent: Lauren Bishop -> infra on-call pager (ops@redwood.com) -> VP Infra

I've attached poc-risk-register.csv. We'll update it after Week 0 smoke tests and circulate at the weekly sync.

Lauren
Senior Performance Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment: poc-risk-register.csv

- We accept the POC gates and timeline (kickoff next Tue 17 Apr 2028).
- Drive link to 120-case suite + sanitized sample data: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b-hel-data-samples (permission set to HeliumData + Redwood emails).
- Procurement will send PO template today; we'll try to get the signed PO within 5 business days.
- Network whitelist: we can provide the IP ranges tomorrow morning.

Also: we agree with the escalation flow. If a blocking bug hits the performance soak, please use the "urgent-poc" Slack channel and escalate to Stephanie.

Next: Marcus, if you can send the calendar invite and the Week 0 smoke-test checklist (with specific make/break commands), we'll be ready to go.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Kate
